body: The key ring and canned corn are packed together. Violet powder from the insecticide test coats both, with a clean print where a glove held them.
title: Wrapped bread with canned corn at the second evening

body: A work radio with its dial taped down on one channel, spare batteries beside it. Someone told the crew to stay off the air and listen only, days before the road was closed.
title: Taped radio in the site truck
